name: numi-lab
description: Train, evaluate, and extend robots locally through Codex and Apple Silicon.

interface.shortDescription: Your Apple-native robotics laboratory inside Codex.
interface.longDescription: Turn natural-language intent into local robot simulation, training, evaluation, and new capabilities on Apple Silicon. Codex configures and extends the laboratory while Numi runs native Metal physics and MLX learning, preserves reproducible evidence, and keeps the user in control.
